title: A gate's options name the command that carries each out
goal: A gate may give each option a do field (the argv that carries it out, or the id of the item whose work adds that command); backlog.py check warns on a blocking gate of an open item whose options have neither, naming the gate; a planted gate in test_backlog.py fails the warning; kb/_self/backlog.md and /kb-backlog describe the field, so an operator answer never waits on a command nobody planned
